method: Built-in image generation: vertical outpainting of existing artwork
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / vertical outpainting. Edit target: the supplied original purple birthday invitation. Deliver ONE finished flat artwork image, tall portrait EXACTLY 1024 pixels wide by 2176 pixels high (8:17 aspect ratio), no device or UI. The original image is 1024x1536: preserve that existing composition as the central 1024x1536 region, extending the canvas with 320 pixels of NEW painted artwork above and 320 pixels below. Do not shrink the existing design into a smaller inset, do not crop it, do not stretch it, and preserve all existing central lettering, objects, composition and colors as closely as possible. Exact existing purple cursive words remain 'Livia is turning 10', with the hearts unchanged; do not add any other words or redraw it in another font. Generate believable seamless scene continuation into the added top and bottom: extend the existing lavender/pearl balloons, curling purple ribbons and sparse tiny gold/purple confetti naturally into the new top; continue the lavender tabletop, gift-base/cake-plate edges, trailing satin ribbons and a few tiny confetti pieces into the new bottom. Match the exact soft pastel lilac lighting and photographic illustration style. The extension must contain real crisp decorative artwork, not empty color padding, blurred copies, mirrored bands, gradients-only filler, duplicated cakes/gifts or stacked scenes. Keep the outermost top and bottom 12% decorative, with the title and main focal content in the middle so small decorative-edge cropping can adapt this tall mobile artwork to other screen proportions. Low-detail space near the upper corners and bottom edge will hold real app controls later, but DO NOT draw controls, icons, share/close buttons, labels, borders, rounded corners, screenshots, black background or watermarks. One continuous full-bleed tall birthday scene.
